Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_found VARCHAR2(1);
 v_gmt_time DATE;
 s_coll_date_gmt DATE;
 
 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id, coll_date, c.product_code,
 component_prefix, component_count,
 decode(NVL(length(unit_id), 0),13,
 decode(system_label_decision,'Mq','N',
 '','N',
 '92','N',
 '48','N',
 '03','N',
 '59','N',
 '14','N',
 '70','N',
 '25','N',
 '81','N',
 'P3','N',
 'A3','N',
 'B3','N',
 'C3','N','Y'),
 decode(system_label_decision,'39','N',
 '','N',
 '71','N',
 'Y')) component_labeled, 
 product_desc, chapter_id
 from components c, valid_products vp
 where 
 coll_date = :s_coll_date and
 --IM# 5502 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(s_coll_date_gmt) and
 c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 c.product_code != 'NONE' and
 relabel_product_code is null and
 pooled_component_id is null and
 vp.product_code = SUBSTR(c.product_code,1,5) and
 vp.unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(unit_id), 0),13,'I','C') and
 vp.cell_count_flag in ('Y','O')
 order by 1;
begin
 -- IM# 5243 (Converts local date to GMT date)
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :CTRL_BLK_2.s_coll_date, v_gmt_time);
 s_coll_date_gmt := TRUNC(v_gmt_time);
 else
 s_coll_date_gmt := TRUNC(sysdate);
 end if;
 --
 :Global.err_cnt := 'N'; -- IM# 2481
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if nvl(:global.err_cnt, 'N') != 'Y' then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 temp_found := 'N';
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 temp_found := 'Y';
 :unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :product_code := c1_rec.product_code;
 :component_prefix := c1_rec.component_prefix;
 :component_count := c1_rec.component_count;
 :s_component_label_flag := c1_rec.component_labeled;
 :s_product_code_desc := c1_rec.product_desc;
 :s_chapter_id := c1_rec.chapter_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(c1_rec.unit_id,c1_rec.coll_date,c1_rec.chapter_id);
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 if temp_found = 'N'
 then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2'); -- added by mukesh
 show_error('0123');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.err_cnt = 'N' then 
 :Global.err_cnt := 'Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 end if;
 if error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then-- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: PROCESS_COUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE process_count IS
 temp_product_count number;
 exit_excep exception;
begin
 if nvl(:GLOBAL.old_count,'12345678') = nvl(:component_count,'12345678') then
 return;
 end if;
 if :s_component_label_flag = 'Y' 
 then
 show_error('9788');
 :component_count := :GLOBAL.old_count;
 return;
 else
 :system.message_level := 5;
 
 IF :component_count is not null THEN
 begin
 select product_count
 into temp_product_count
 from valid_products
 where product_code = SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5) 
 and unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id), 0),7,'C','I') --Modified for Code128
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from valid_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :component_count < temp_product_count
 then
 show_error('9789', 'CMCO');
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id,
 :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :product_code,
 'CMCO',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CMCO not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 END IF;
 begin
 update components
 set component_count = :component_count,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code ;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 IF :component_count is null 
 or nvl(:component_count,'0') >= nvl(temp_product_count,'0') 
 THEN
 begin
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :product_code and
 inter_code = 'CMCO';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 END IF;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_success
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 return;
 end if; 
 end if;
exception
 when others then
 -- message(sqlerrm);
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_ZONE_CONVERSION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_zone_conversion IS
 v_local_time DATE;
 local_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_time);
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_coll_date := trunc(v_local_time);
 else
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_coll_date := trunc(sysdate);
 end if;

END;
